recommendation: Keep the fix as-is because it preserves the seed issue's parent-account lookup capability on the current Account relationship name. Revisit only if PA/FM intentionally wants a compatibility alias for the obsolete partOf wording.
issue_request: FHIR-31366 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested a search for Account.partOf so clients can find subaccounts when the parent Account does not reference its children.
initial_application: No source-history commit mentioning FHIR-31366 was found, and the R5 v5.0.0 Account search-parameter bundle did not include a partOf search. Later Account relationship work moved the element from Account.partOf to Account.relatedAccount and then to Account.parent, but no parent search parameter existed in the current source.
additional_context: Account is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-20997 replaced Account.partOf with Account.relatedAccount in R5, and FHIR-44682 replaced that structure with Account.parent for R6 while updating the related-account search parameter only to guarantor-account. Current search-parameter conventions use code parent for .parent reference elements.
reconciliation: Added Account-parent to source/account/bundle-Account-search-params.xml with code parent, type reference, path/expression Account.parent, normative standards status, and the standard build SearchParameter URL.
source_changes: source/account/bundle-Account-search-params.xml: added the Account-parent SearchParameter for Account.parent.
